name: Wayfarer's Brigandine
kind: armour set for the villagers (skinned to their CharacterArmature)
description: A road-worn brigandine of studded leather over dark red wool, Lord Velscour's sigil across a ragged travelling cloak and his copper V on the breast, belt, rondels, shins and helm: square iron spaulders, iron rerebraces and greaves, and a great helm with a pair of crest boards.

meshes.Armor: body, arms, legs and the set's gauntlets

hide_when_worn: the villager's body meshes (every mesh not named V_*)
